description: The article introduces a multiple regression model in which the aptitude variable enters as a continuous predictor and visual design is coded with two dummy variables, dumOpt and dumSub, each carrying a quadratic interaction term with ability.
title: Quadratic aptitude-treatment interaction regression model

description: A high-inference rating system was developed, blending deductive and inductive approaches, to code lecturers' instructional clarity from video recordings at three-minute intervals synchronized with ESM signals.
title: Qualitative coding manual for instructional clarity with three indicators

description: The article's organizing approach is a qualitative meta-synthesis: rather than computing a new pooled estimate, it compares and contrasts the assumptions and findings of existing meta-analyses of PBL.
title: Qualitative meta-synthesis

description: The article frames an explanatory approach in which \"motion measurement using motion capture and gaze measurement using an eye-tracking device were combined\" to quantify differences in body movement and gaze by skill level.
title: Quantitative motion-capture and eye-tracking analysis of medical skill proficiency
